input.command:
cd src && sed -i 's/SECONDS_PER_UNIT/MS_PER_UNIT/g; s/{ s: 1, m: 60, h: 3600, d: 86400 }/{ s: 1000, m: 60_000, h: 3_600_000, d: 86_400_000 }/; s/length in seconds/length in milliseconds/' duration.ts
sed -i 's/ \* 1000//' cache.ts retry.ts scheduler.ts
sed -i 's/String(parseDuration(wait))/String(parseDuration(wait) \/ 1000)/' http.ts
sed -i 's/parseDuration(settings.timeout)}s/parseDuration(settings.timeout) \/ 1000}s/; s/parseDuration(settings.ttl)}s/parseDuration(settings.ttl) \/ 1000}s/' report.ts
sed -i 's/MIN_TTL_SECONDS = 5;/MIN_TTL_MS = 5 * 1000;/; s/MAX_TTL_SECONDS = 24/MAX_TTL_MS = 24/; s/60 \* 60;/60 * 60 * 1000;/; s/MIN_TTL_SECONDS/MIN_TTL_MS/g; s/MAX_TTL_SECONDS/MAX_TTL_MS/g; s/seconds/ms/g' validate.ts
cd ../test && sed -i -E 's/(parseDuration\("[^"]*"\), )([0-9]+)\)/\1\2000)/' duration.test.ts
cd .. && git diff && cat package.json | grep -A5 scripts; npm test 2>&1 | tail -15
